scope: One small synthetic TB360 AAC file through actual candidate UI, client, Worker, codecs, writer and cleanup; 1 GiB contract unchanged
pickerSubstitution: showSaveFilePicker only; returns one new native OPFS output handle; OS picker is not tested

downloadedReceipt.firstAttempt: direct, committed, verified; metadata hash compared and whole-file hash observed after commit
downloadedReceipt.secondAttempt: download-request only; not a verified filesystem save

uiObservations.beforeExecution: switch legacy/indexed without loading codec fork; legacy starts without preselected destination; indexed does not
uiObservations.explicitDestination: one picker call supplies an initially empty native OPFS file; native isSameEntry verified
uiObservations.saveAndCleanup: separate successful save and internal cleanup text; result remains available until clear
uiObservations.clearResult: real UI clear after complete downloads; saved file size/hash unchanged
uiObservations.registry: explicit empty listing before/after; no automatic cleanup; no unknown-record deletion
uiObservations.vendor: dedicated combined indexed fork only during conversion; legacy fork absent
uiObservations.internalRegistryNamespace: absent before and after UI clear
uiObservations.harnessOutputCleanup: only proven harness-owned output and empty directory removed after successful recovery

qualityProfile.thresholdRule: strictly below threshold fails; equality passes
qualityProfile.scope: RGB per decoded eye; frame indices are zero-based decoded pair positions, not embedded frame IDs or eye-marker recognition

frameQuality.sequenceEncoding: ASCII decimal frameIndex:squaredErrorSum:channelSampleCount followed by LF; one record per compared frame, independently hashed for each eye
frameQuality.zeroErrorPSNR: positive infinity; null minimum means no finite minimum; consult framesByEye
frameQuality.frameIdentity: Decoded pair order only. No embedded frame ID or eye-ID schema is assumed.

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: OS picker and permission dialogue are not exercised; only showSaveFilePicker is substituted with a native OPFS handle.
Failure/recovery UI state is covered by six local event-handler tests with doubles, not by this successful native media trial.
No 5/10 GB trial through this UI; separate private runtime qualification does not expand the 1 GiB candidate contract.
No real camera, 60 fps, long AAC, target VR player, novice usability, speedup or public deployment acceptance.
publication: Allowlisted summary; original ownership identities, tickets and runtime paths retained locally.
